title: Main Street Farmers Market Draws 30-Plus Vendors to the Outlet Shoppes
excerpt: More than 30 vendors set up at the Laredo Main Street Farmers Market at The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 21, with fresh produce, artisan goods, holiday gifts and a Salvation Army Angel Tree.
content:
More than 30 vendors drew shoppers to the Laredo Main Street Farmers Market at The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 21, for a morning of local shopping ahead of the holidays.

Vendors offered fresh produce, artisan goods, clothing and toys, giving shoppers a mix of everyday essentials and handmade gifts.

The Salvation Army used the market to promote its Angel Tree, through which donors pick a child's wish and buy gifts for them. Santa and Mrs. Claus also visited the market to spread holiday cheer.

The next market is set for Dec. 12 at The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo.

Source: Laredo Main Street Farmers Market, Nov. 22, 2026.
